goal: An offer from the companies you want

phases.name: Warm up
phases.focus: A routine first; easies by pattern
phases.exit: Studied on most days of the last two weeks

phases.name: DSA foundations
phases.focus: NeetCode 150 by pattern, re-solving failures after 3 days
phases.exit: About 70% of fresh mediums solved in 35 minutes without hints

phases.name: Depth and design
phases.focus: Harder and company-tagged problems, contests, system design, practice interviews
phases.exit: Two mock interviews passed and one real interview loop done

weeks.label: Week 2
weeks.focus: Easies, plus a well-known medium or two

weeks.label: Week 4
weeks.focus: Re-solve every failed problem without hints; plan January
